titles: Build a CLI to Summarize Meeting Notes with AI
Summarize Markdown Notes in 4 Seconds with AI
Tiny AI Meeting Summarizer: Setup to Error Handling
publish.description: Watch how to build a tiny command line tool that summarizes meeting notes with an AI model. You will see how to install the OpenAI client and dotenv, store the API key in a .env file, call the chat completions endpoint, and add friendly error handling. The demo runs on real weekly sync notes and produces bullet points and action items in about four seconds.
highlights: Install OpenAI client and dotenv packages
Store API key safely in .env file
Call chat completions to summarize notes
Get bullets and action items in seconds
Add friendly error for missing files
